scoring_justification: Recompute ε₁(0) from ε₂(ω) via Kramers‑Kronig; compare band gaps to paper gold; verify peak positions and cross‑artifact consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper‑reported band gaps (HSE06, interpolated to requested strains) and static dielectric constants ε₁ₓ(0), ε₁ᵧ(0) from Table 2 and Table 3, plus ε₂ peak positions.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables 2, 3 and Fig. 6 peak labels; band gaps at −7%, −3%, +7% interpolated linearly from adjacent even‑strain entries in Table 2.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper; interpolation uses midpoint of published values at −8%/−6% etc.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper’s exact numbers or the linear interpolation of reported data points.

outputs.description: Strain-dependent HSE06 band gaps and static dielectric constants (ε₁ₓ(0) and ε₁ᵧ(0)) for monolayer BP at -7%, -3%, 0%, 3%, and 7% biaxial strain.
Imaginary part of the dielectric function ε₂(ω) for x and y polarizations at 0% strain, covering 0–12 eV with dense sampling.

output_contract.notes: The static dielectric constants and band gaps are scored by comparison with hidden reference values (paper Table 2 and Table 3) within tolerances. The epsilon2 spectrum is audited for structural validity (non-negative values, energy range, monotonic energy grid).
